name: archipelago-server
post_parameters: -c set -- /archipelago/Archipelago/output/AP_*.zip; [ -e $1 ] || { echo No AP_*.zip found; ls -la /archipelago/Archipelago/output; exit 1; }; exec /archipelago/Archipelago/ArchipelagoServer $1
description: Archipelago multiworld randomizer server. Generate your Archipelago world using the client then place your generated AP_*.zip in the output folder and start the container. This container will always use the latest *.zip file in the output folder.

paths.name: Output Folder
paths.description: Folder containing your AP_*.zip seed file
